latestVersion.changelog:
Agent Dispatch Skill v1.0.0 — initial release

- Provides automatic specialist agent dispatching based on routing rules.
- Core features include intent recognition, rule-based routing and priority, task scheduling, result integration, and fault tolerance with retry/fallback logic.
- Supports parallel task dispatch (up to 2 concurrent tasks).
- Includes metrics and logging for dispatch performance monitoring.
- Offers sample routing rules and usage examples for programming, content creation, and parallel queries.
